one_liner: Help desk with a broad REST Inbox API (OAuth 2.0) plus a Docs API (API key); API is on Standard+ plans with a 15-day self-serve free trial; official hosted MCP server.
notes: auth: the Inbox (Mailbox) API 2.0 is OAuth 2.0 only (Authorization Code for multi-account apps, Client Credentials for internal integrations; both are OAuth). The separate Docs API (knowledge base) uses a per-user API key sent as the HTTP Basic username -> api_key per the rubric. If the grader only considers the Inbox API, this would be ['oauth2']; the Docs API was included since it is an official public Help Scout API. access: a Free plan exists, but the pricing comparison table marks API access as not included on it; Standard/Plus/Pro include API (200/400/800 calls/min) and Standard/Plus offer a 15-day free trial with no credit card -> self_serve_trial. verdict: ready (self-serve trial credentials + documented API); ongoing use needs a paid plan after the trial. mcp: Help Scout's own hosted MCP at https://mcp.helpscout.net/mcp, described in its docs as 'official access'. A community server (drewburchfield/help-scout-mcp-server) also exists.
